scope: Fixed native reference / ideal-observation diagnosis only

cases.scope: Unchanged frozen V12 MPPI and execution validator; full fixed-arm projected disks; entire accepted native polynomial bundle held fixed. Ideal synchronous observations, no ROS, no detector, no native online replan, no Gazebo, no vehicle publication. World advances in fixed simulated steps, not real wall time; observation age .04s and measured-state age 0s are controlled fixtures. Actual 50ms decision deadline is enforced, but host timing is not ROS real-time performance. Post-command search export/render/log overhead excluded from deadline and separately recorded.
